text:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — customers keep asking for a lightweight Optimize surface they can ship in 1–2 sprints. Can we agree on a narrow pilot scope?
Luca (Eng): +1. Need to constrain to batching + simple cache + a quant suggestion rule. Full eval-alerting is bigger.
Sam (ML): For pilot, keep eval-triggered alerts as a checkbox: generate alerts but not auto-remediate. We can surface confidence + sample diffs.
Priya (CS): Customers A & B both said they want actionable recs: % cost savings estimate, expected p99 impact, and a suggested quant level. They don’t need automatic rollout yet.
Luca (Eng): Implementation notes: continuous batching hook + a tiny LRU prefix cache. Risk: cache correctness with streaming responses.
Diego (SRE): Also need a toggle to disable cache per-route and per-tenant. We can ship that in pilot.
Aisha (PM): Suggested MVP acceptance criteria: 1) Recs UI + API, 2) cost & latency estimate for each rec, 3) per-tenant toggle, 4) alerts produced for eval regressions (email + console) but not auto actions. Thoughts?
Sam (ML): Add: show expected quality delta estimate (probability of >5% generation divergence). We'll surface as "quality risk".
Priya (CS): For rollout, pilot customers: Customer A (conversational assistant) and Customer C (search embeddings). They will trial batching + quant recs.
Luca (Eng): Timeline: two-week spike to validate batching + cache primitives, then 3-week build for UI + API + telemetry. If spike fails, fallback to just advisory recs (no runtime changes).
Aisha (PM): What are minimal telemetry requirements to sign-off?
Diego (SRE): We need per-recommendation simulated estimate: tokens saved, estimated p95/p99 change, and an attribution id for replay. Also basic alerting on spike in request errors post-apply.
Sam (ML): Eval-alert gating: define threshold: precision > 0.75 for flagged regressions and severity tiers (info/warn/critical) based on quality delta. Pilot can use conservative thresholds.
Priya (CS): Customer asks: expose why a quant suggestion made — show sample prompt -> before/after tokens + short diff snippet. They want to see it before turning it on.
Luca (Eng): Ok, UI will include sample before/after tokens + estimated cost delta and a small diff sample. Backend will run a short replay on recent traffic subsets to generate the sample.
Aisha (PM): Tradeoffs we should call out in the doc: - Batch larger => better cost but higher tail latency; - Aggressive quant => cost up, potential quality risk; - Cache prefix => risk of stale outputs for dynamic contexts.
Sam (ML): For quant recs we should map to supported profiles: q4_0, q8_0, int8 dynamic. Recommend conservative defaults and an "experiment" flag for customers who opt in.
Diego (SRE): Safety net: a kill-switch per-tenant + automatic rollback if error-rate > 2x baseline for 5 min. ops-bot: deploy can wire alerting channel to #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: Note: automated alert subscription added to thread for rollout warnings.
Priya (CS): Acceptance gating from customers: they want a small A/B in prod (1% traffic) showing cost delta and no >5% quality regressions over 48h. We should bake that into pilot plan.
Luca (Eng): Need to confirm infra cost for replay runs — will add estimate to spike.
Aisha (PM): Next steps: Luca & Sam run spike proposal doc by EOD Fri. Priya to confirm pilot dates with customers next week. I'll draft the MVP launch checklist and share in this thread.
Priya (CS): Happy to coordinate pilot kickoff once dates confirmed.
Sam (ML): I'll include evaluation metrics and thresholds in the spike doc (precision target, sample size, confidence intervals).
Luca (Eng): I'll stub the API proto for recs and the per-tenant toggles, then iterate.
Aisha (PM): Great — if we stick to these boundaries we can ship a meaningful pilot without over-scoping. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): +1 :party_parrot:
Diego (SRE): Will also add runbook lines for rollback, and a dashboard template.
Aisha (PM): Thanks team — closing for now, will post the MVP checklist in this thread when ready.
